## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem, scope and resulting behavior.

## Related issue

Use `Closes #<number>` only when all acceptance criteria are met; use `Refs #<number>` for partial work.

## Evidence

List commands/checks actually run, their results, and checks not run with reasons.

Use `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`. For data changes, include a minimal fixture and the source/time of the observation. Tests using fixtures do not confirm live TSE availability or election status.

## Limits and review

- [ ] The diff is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Evidence and examples contain no private data or credentials.
- [ ] Compatibility, behavior changes, limitations and rollback are described where applicable.

Include election/year/round, office, UF, municipality, source URL and source timestamp when applicable. Distinguish missing, partial, stale and official final data. Use synthetic fixtures for reproducible cases.
